title: Витубика, история 2 «Без лица»: Тёма зевает вместе с аватаром (AI-картинки + 2D-анимация кодом)
notes: Первый пресет способа «AI-аниме 2D» (08.11.2026). Владелец для историй Витубики выбрал кодовую графику, этот способ сохранён как пресет и воркфлоу для других проектов.
Потрачено 39 ₽ (10 картинок, одна из них забракована). Баланс Polza 122.56 → 83.56.
Картинки лежат в paths.src; результаты Polza живут 7 дней, поэтому файлы скачаны сразу.

generation.style: TV anime style (clean thin line art, flat cel shading with one shadow tone, soft colors)

images.prompt: Anime character reference sheet, modern Japanese TV anime style (slice-of-life, clean thin line art, flat cel shading with one shadow tone, soft colors). Character: Tyoma, a tired Russian guy around 22 years old, messy dark brown hair with bangs, slim, wearing a plain heather-grey hoodie with drawstrings, black over-ear gaming headphones on his head. Tired look: half-closed heavy eyelids, visible dark circles under the eyes, slightly slouched. Layout on a plain light grey background: left side full-body turnaround (front, three-quarter, side); right side a grid of 6 head close-ups with expressions: neutral tired, eyes closed, big anime yawn with mouth wide open and eyes squeezed shut, soft shy smile, surprised, blink half-closed. Consistent design across all views. No text, no labels, no watermark.

Anime background art in the same TV anime style as the reference image (clean line art, painted cel-style background like a modern slice-of-life anime), vertical 9:16. NO people, NO characters. Interior of a small cramped bedroom of a young streamer at night, seen at seated eye level looking toward the back wall: a large window with the night city outside (apartment blocks with many lit yellow windows, a distant TV tower with red lights, dark blue sky), thin curtains, anime and game posters taped on the wall, a shelf with a few figurines and a small plant, a string of warm fairy lights along the wall, an unmade bed with a rumpled dark blue blanket on the right side, a hoodie thrown on the bed. The room is dark and lit mainly by cool cyan-blue monitor glow coming from the viewer's side and violet city light from the window. Cozy, lonely late-night mood. The lower 40 percent of the image is the dim back of the room and floor, simple, without important details. No text, no watermark.

Same character Tyoma from the reference sheet (messy dark brown hair, black over-ear headphones on his head, heather-grey hoodie with white drawstrings), same TV anime style with clean line art and cel shading. Vertical 9:16 medium close-up shot: he sits at his computer at night and looks slightly down-left past the viewer at his monitor, head and shoulders and upper chest visible, body cut off by the bottom edge of the image, shoulders relaxed and slightly slouched, arms down out of frame.
